fact_text: About 88% of retail payments in Pakistan are digitised in one form or another, according to a State Bank of Pakistan report cited by Visa's country manager.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Visa & HBL She's Next Grant: Apply Now for USD 10,000 Funding in Pakistan | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-16)

fact_text: Pakistan recorded about 9.1 billion digital transactions in 2024, a sharp rise on the year before, per Visa's country manager, who gave the figure as approximate.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Visa & HBL She's Next Grant: Apply Now for USD 10,000 Funding in Pakistan | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-16)

fact_text: About 6.5 billion of Pakistan's 2024 digital transactions came through mobile banking channels, a volume the Visa country manager said was nearly double the prior year.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Visa & HBL She's Next Grant: Apply Now for USD 10,000 Funding in Pakistan | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-16)

fact_text: Pakistan has roughly 2.2 million credit cards in use, according to the programme introduction.

fact_text: About 10% of women entrepreneurs in an SME digitisation index, run with HBL, accept only digital payments and no cash, yet their businesses report healthy double-digit growth.

fact_text: Withholding taxes of up to 2% are applied within online deliveries, so unregistered sellers on e-commerce platforms enter the tax net without registering a business.

fact_text: The Visa executive called the State Bank of Pakistan a very proactive regulator, with consumer protection and cybersecurity central to its policies and to the industry's strategy.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Visa & HBL She's Next Grant: Apply Now for USD 10,000 Funding in Pakistan | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-16)

fact_text: The Visa executive said government leadership, from the prime minister to the State Bank, treats digitising the economy, citizen services and payment flows as critical to national growth.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Visa & HBL She's Next Grant: Apply Now for USD 10,000 Funding in Pakistan | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-16)

fact_text: The Visa executive argued that platform selling moves informal women sellers into the formal economy, with company registration becoming the next step once their businesses grow.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Visa & HBL She's Next Grant: Apply Now for USD 10,000 Funding in Pakistan | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-16)

fact_text: The Visa executive said women entrepreneurs in Pakistan face gender bias when raising investment, often falling back on their own savings, friends and family.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Visa & HBL She's Next Grant: Apply Now for USD 10,000 Funding in Pakistan | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-16)

fact_text: Women sellers in tier-two and tier-three cities often lack transport and mobility for courier runs or market trips, so a platform that handles delivery and payments removes a key barrier.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Visa & HBL She's Next Grant: Apply Now for USD 10,000 Funding in Pakistan | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-16)

fact_text: Visa describes itself as a network-based middle layer between merchants and financial institutions, supplying technical services, network access and cybersecurity services to banks, fintechs and merchants.

fact_text: Visa's fraud approach has three layers: yearly financial-literacy campaigns such as Stay Secure, guiding partner banks to deploy AI-enabled tools, and Visa's own global transaction monitoring.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Visa & HBL She's Next Grant: Apply Now for USD 10,000 Funding in Pakistan | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-16)

fact_text: Visa and HBL's She is Next programme gives five winners USD 10,000 grants each, plus a one-year mentorship programme; applications stay open until early January 2026.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Visa & HBL She's Next Grant: Apply Now for USD 10,000 Funding in Pakistan | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-16)

fact_text: Eligibility covers women-led businesses that have operated for two years with revenue of about USD 5,000, as described in the programme.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Visa & HBL She's Next Grant: Apply Now for USD 10,000 Funding in Pakistan | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-16)

fact_text: Selection runs through an application form, shortlisting, a virtual elevator pitch and document validation; 10 shortlisted entrepreneurs then pitch to an independent judging panel after HBL-partner rehearsals.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Visa & HBL She's Next Grant: Apply Now for USD 10,000 Funding in Pakistan | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-16)

fact_text: The grant is paid as a single lump sum rather than in instalments, and the mentorship runs alongside it so winners can get advice on deploying the funds.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Visa & HBL She's Next Grant: Apply Now for USD 10,000 Funding in Pakistan | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-16)

fact_text: The first edition gave over 100 women, beyond the winners, mentorship from leading industry practitioners on topics from digital marketing to financial management and fundraising.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Visa & HBL She's Next Grant: Apply Now for USD 10,000 Funding in Pakistan | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-16)

fact_text: The She is Next Club, a parallel mentorship for top applicants who did not win, reached about 106 women in its previous run.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Visa & HBL She's Next Grant: Apply Now for USD 10,000 Funding in Pakistan | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-16)

fact_text: About 16 industry practitioners delivered training and mentorship to participants of the She is Next Club in its previous run.

fact_text: HBL is an equal partner in the She is Next programme, extending its on-ground reach through branches, employees and customers, and its senior leaders mentor the entrepreneurs.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Visa & HBL She's Next Grant: Apply Now for USD 10,000 Funding in Pakistan | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-16)
